list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, names/descriptions/grades as PlayStation publishes them, verified 19 Nov 2026 against the list mirrored by Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6, OutpuTLag, GTAViceCityHub). 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned. There are no online trophies: all 55 are single-player.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. From the official description, it is simply the reward for completing the whole list, so treat the roadmap below as the route to it. Keep the tracker at 54 of 55 and the last trophy you earn will trigger this one.
steps: Check the progress bar reads 54 of 55
Earn the final trophy — the platinum unlocks with it

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play through the story from the start and it unlocks when that mission ends — it cannot be missed, since the story must pass through it. If you are starting fresh, just follow the opening objectives.
steps: Follow the opening mission Gone Fishing

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: From the official description, this unlocks when Chapter 1 is complete. Play every story mission in chapter order and it pops at the chapter's end — story progress only, nothing to find or collect. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a precaution, since sources conflict on whether missions can be replayed.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 1 in order
The trophy unlocks at the chapter end

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: From the official description, this needs 100% completion — the game's own completion counter, worth gold. Rockstar has not published what the 100% covers, so finish every tracked strand in this guide: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities, exploration and money, and watch the in-game stats screen. It is the last trophy before the platinum for most players, so leave it to Stage 5.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands
Complete every collectible and activity counter in this guide
Check the in-game 100% stat — this unlocks at 100%

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.when_missed: Nothing here is a one-shot fail, but 100% needs every counter finished — do not leave a strand half-done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: From the official description, the count is 250 stunts — the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida. There is no single spot named in the official list, so build the count naturally while travelling, and use fast vehicles and ramps when you want to farm it. This guide cannot count stunts for you; check the in-game stats.
steps: Drive and ride everywhere — stunts count as you play
Use jumps and ramps to add airtime stunts

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

locations.label: Vice-Dale County — 55 stunt jumps
Kelly County — 29 stunt jumps
Mariana County — 17 stunt jumps
Lummox County — 16 stunt jumps
Leonard County — 13 stunt jumps
Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump — dirt mound at the southeast fence, a shortcut into the base

trophies.locations_note: Stunt totals reported by PowerPyx / GTABase: 397 stunts in all — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps; any 300 count for 100%. Find stunt spots via Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots, and track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: From the official description, try each type of activity once — the list counts 9 activity types. Sample one of each: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, and the rest the game offers as you explore. One attempt each is enough; no wins or medals are needed.
steps: Open the activities list as you explore Leonida
Try one of each of the 9 activity types
It unlocks after the ninth type

Hunting — Mount Kalaga National Park

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: From the official description, earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them. Practise each range until the gold score is comfortable before moving on; the range is repeatable, so nothing here is missable. Leave the hardest ones until your aim and weapon handling are upgraded.

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

locations.label: Griffin Shooting Range — north-west Vice City; 6 challenges x 3 gold difficulties = 18 gold medals
Rodgers Ranch — north-east of Port Gellhorn; 6 challenges x 4 gold difficulties = 24 gold medals

trophies.locations_note: Buy a $5 waiver pass from the clerk at each range first — the challenges then appear on the map. Track them under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missable_note: Completion counter: a win is needed at every one of the 14 locations — clear each location as you find it.
trophies.guide: From the official description, a win is needed at every drone-race location — the list tracks 14 locations. Win one race at each spot; a loss costs nothing but a retry, so race each location until you win before moving on. Because it is an 'at every location' counter, this guide flags it missable in the sense that every location must be cleared.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race
Win the race at that location
Repeat until every location has a win

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

trophies.locations_note: No published list names all 14 locations yet. In-game, Top Fun drone races appear as blue map icons when you are within about 100 m — use Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones to filter them (GTABase). Each location has 3 time trials; the trophy needs one win per location, the 100% checklist needs all 42 trials.
trophies.when_missed: Not a one-shot fail, but the trophy needs a win at every one of the 14 locations — clear each location as you find it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: From the official description, win 20 different races across Leonida — road, off-road, boat or air, whatever the game offers. Different races count, so vary the events rather than replaying one favourite. Losses do not hurt; only wins in new events add to the count.
steps: Vary the events — repeats of one race do not add new ones

Cross-country racing venues — three venues across Leonida (per launch reviews)

trophies.locations_note: 40 races to choose from; winning the same race again does not count (GTABase). Launch reviews count four street-racing venues, three cross-country venues and two race tracks (gtasixmap).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: From the official description, beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, so it is about the catch, not the spot. Find Cal's fishing challenge, fish it, and out-catch him. If you lose, challenge him again; nothing here is a one-shot fail.
steps: Fish the challenge and beat Cal's catch

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: From the official description, hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand leads to one specific animal — follow Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then take the animal down. It is tied to Bret, so do not skip his strand, and it is not missable: the hunt waits until you take it.
steps: Take the unique-animal hunt when offered

Target Decks — purple icons; hunt the animals on his decks and bring them back as Jason

trophies.locations_note: Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway (GTABase).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set is complete when every card in it is found. Pick cards up as you explore rather than leaving them for one giant sweep — three full sets are needed, and the world is the only source the description names.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore

Kyle Lewicki — Vice City Narcos; back corridor of Dynamix Fitness, on a bench, Bayside

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missable_note: Completion counter: 100 different locations — repeats at one spot do not count.
trophies.guide: From the official description, use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations. The count is the locations, not the uses — a repeat at the same spot adds nothing, so keep moving to new places. This guide flags it as a completion counter: cover new ground steadily and it finishes during normal exploration.
steps: Use WAiNK It at a new location
Move on — repeats at one spot do not count

source.name: GTA 6 achievements list — GTAViceCityHub

trophies.locations_note: WAiNK scans come in four kinds (PowerPyx via GTABase): 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags — any 100 count. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB) and scan anything new. No published list names 100 individual scan spots yet.
trophies.when_missed: A completion counter — all 100 locations must be covered before 100%.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 50 challenges — the small objectives the game tracks across Leonida. They stack up as you play every system, so chase the ones nearest to done and let the rest come with normal play. Check the challenges list in-game to see which are close.

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

trophies.locations_note: 50 of the 80 challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70 (GTABase). No single location — challenges span every system in Leonida.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: From the official description, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Your partner must be present and the escape must succeed — a quiet area and a fast car help, and a failed escape just means trying again.
steps: Play with your partner beside you
Escape and stay hidden until it clears

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

locations.label: Train tunnel north of Ambrosia — Kelly County; shakes off cops and helicopters

trophies.locations_note: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner, get a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there (GTABase).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: One-shot streak: 3 shops back-to-back, partner present, wanted level kept the whole time — a broken chain must be restarted.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Three shop robberies in a row, partner present, wanted level kept the whole time — if the wanted level drops or the run breaks, the chain resets, so start again. Keep a manual save before you begin (precaution) and pick three shops close together.
steps: Rob a shop with your partner, keeping your wanted level
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing it

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Casa de Empeno — north Vice City; opens after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3)
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds — north Vice City; opens after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3)
Donovan Banks & Co — north Vice City; opens after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3)

trophies.locations_note: The same three stores are the Sneakthief targets. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not just heat) through all three shops; the trophy can pop about 30 seconds after the third shop — if it does not, rob a fourth (GTABase).
trophies.when_missed: The chain breaks if you lose your Wanted Level mid-run — the official description makes the streak the condition, so a broken run must be restarted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missable_note: Completion counter: 100 different vehicles must be found before 100%.
trophies.guide: From the official description, discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles and the game logs each new one — new models count, the same model twice does not. Check the vehicle list in-game to see what is still missing, and hop into anything unfamiliar as you explore.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you see

source.name: GTA 6 achievements list — GTAViceCityHub

trophies.locations_note: GTABase: scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app without driving them — stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this finishes on the way to 100%.
trophies.when_missed: A completion counter — all 100 vehicles must be found before 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missable_note: One-shot condition: 5 takedowns in a single use of Combat Focus — a use that ends early does not count.
trophies.guide: From the official description, take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it only when five enemies are in range, then chain the takedowns fast — if the focus ends at four, try again. A manual save beforehand is a sensible precaution, and a group of enemies in the open is the right setup.
steps: Trigger Combat Focus and take all five down before it ends

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming) lasts only a few seconds — fill Focus first and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count (GTABase). Try it during a gang operation, e.g. in Port Gellhorn.
trophies.when_missed: One-shot condition in the official description: five takedowns in a single use of Combat Focus — a use that ends early does not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: From the official description, make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. Leave in a way the schedule never planned: take an aircraft and go. It is a stunt-style trophy, so expect a wanted response and a fast exit once you are airborne.

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: VCIA — Gates E3 and E4; steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge

trophies.locations_note: Planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge; take off and get about 1 km away from the airport (GTABase).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is about the Rhino tanks — get into the thick of them and come out the other side. The description gives no count, so treat it as a combat moment: provoke the Rhinos and survive the encounter. It is repeatable, so a failed attempt just means trying again.

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Mile Zero Air Station — south-west island of Mariana County; tanks at the south end of the base

trophies.locations_note: Steal a tank and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops (GTABase).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_note: One-shot condition: 'without being detected' — being spotted fails the attempt and it must be retried.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob a jewelry store without being detected. The whole robbery must stay undetected — plan the approach, move quietly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails; leave, reset, and try again. A manual save before you start is a sensible precaution.
steps: Rob it and leave without ever being spotted

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Casa de Empeno — Vice City (smallest store; no back door needing the Snap Gun)
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds — Vice City (GTABase recommends this one for Sneakthief)
Donovan Banks & Co — Vice City

trophies.locations_note: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) gives the Snap Gun, which opens locked back doors without raising the alarm. Reported safe codes (PowerPyx via CryptoGames, single source — verify in-game): Casa de Empeno 1680, Richardson Jewelry 6815, Donovan Banks & Co 0104. Wiping the security footage keeps police from getting your description if you leave before they arrive.
trophies.when_missed: One-shot condition: 'without being detected' — being spotted fails the attempt and it must be retried.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missable_note: Each vault needs its escape: the official description pairs the robbery with escaping, so a failed escape means redoing that vault.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob 5 bank vaults and escape — each vault robbery must end in an escape, so a vault robbed without escaping does not count. Plan each escape route before you go in, and do not rush the fifth. Bank vaults are repeatable targets, so a failed escape just means redoing that vault.

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Fleeca — VCIA
Fleeca — Tequesta
Lombank — Downtown
Fleeca — Downtown
Lombank — Ocean Beach
Fleeca — Ocean Beach
Lombank — Ocean Beach (second branch — check the individual map icon, not just the brand)
Shorefront — Ocean Beach

trophies.locations_note: Large vaults unlock after the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...'. A vault only opens when a security van arrives and a guard carries a briefcase inside — follow a van, or buy a $10,000 tip from Yasmani (after 2 Payday Loans robberies). Loot the vault, cash drawer and safe. Each vault robbery triggers an instant 4-star wanted level, so plan the escape first. Use Map > Robberies > Bank Jobs to track each branch (GTADB, CryptoGames).
trophies.when_missed: Each vault needs its escape: the official description pairs the robbery with escaping, so a failed escape means redoing that vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_note: The escape is part of the condition in the official description — a robbery without an escape does not count.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob an armored truck and escape. Stop an armored truck, take it, and escape — the escape is part of the trophy, so a robbery that ends in capture does not count. Watch the roads for a truck on its route, hit it, and have your getaway ready before you start.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: Box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away — or rob a bank vault, which counts too, as long as you escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray (GTABase). No fixed truck route is published yet.
trophies.when_missed: The escape is part of the condition in the official description — a robbery without an escape does not count.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: From the official description, explore all of Leonida — the list tracks 52 areas. Drive the whole map, including the far corners, and watch the area counter in-game. This finishes naturally if you chase the other exploration trophies, but check the map for any region you have never entered.
steps: Drive across Leonida region by region
Visit the far corners, not just Vice City

source.name: GTA 6 achievements list — GTAViceCityHub

trophies.locations_note: No published list names all 52 areas yet. Leonida has 5 counties (PowerPyx map guide): Mariana, Vice-Dale, Kelly, Leonard and Lummox. Drive region by region, including the far corners, and watch the in-game area counter.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — the list tracks 9 gangs. Hit a different gang's operation each time and keep count of which gangs are done. Operations are repeatable targets, so a failed hit just means trying that gang again.
steps: Rob one belonging to a gang

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

locations.label: Kingfishers — Sunrise RV Park, Pelican Valley, Grassrivers (also: Fishing Shacks, Manatee Motel)
Kolts & Associates — Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (all 5 operations in/just north of Port Gellhorn)
M7 — M7 Compound
La Polilla Negra — Palmer Fishing Warehouse, Watson Bay
Final Chapter — Farm Fix Meth Lab, Ambrosia (also: Irons Building Supply)
San4San — JanJak's Garage, La Perle, Vice City (also: Sound4Sond Studio)
PTT Youngin$ — Southside compound, Vice City (2 standard operations; Ultimate Edition adds a third that does not count for 100%)
The Guardia Brothers — Casa Guardia

Other Criminals — Cigar Import Front (also: Exotic Animals Front, Slator Towing Inc, Chatfield Storage & Logistics, Leonida Carrier Warehouse, Gas Station Meth Front, Backroom Weed Front, Carter Mining Boathouse)

trophies.locations_note: 39 Illegal Operations in all (KeenGamer, PowerPyx); the trophy needs one per gang, 100% needs all 39. Operations only appear on the map once you walk into them — use Map > Robberies > Illegal Operations and Progress > Gangs to track which gang still shows zero. An operation only counts when every key valuable is collected, including the safe.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: From the official description, enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It is a quiet world moment — no combat and no timer named in the description — so do it whenever you are passing the beach.

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: Location unconfirmed: no specific bar is published yet — GTABase (19 Nov) lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. The trophy is a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, Vice City; any cocktail spot on the Ocean Beach strip is the lead to check.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: From the official description, smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a vehicle showroom and out the other side — pick a fast car, aim for the glass, and keep going. It is a stunt-style world moment, so expect a wanted response after.
steps: Get a fast car inside or aimed at it

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Vehicle showroom — south of Vice City; the blue Banshee inside

trophies.locations_note: Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car — it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: From the official description, follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that bowling alley and bowl — follow through on the shot. One full game is the safe way to be sure it registers, and the alley is open whenever you want a break from the story.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Kingpin Bowling — Port Gellhorn, south of town, near Moses' chop shop

trophies.locations_note: A Kolt & Associates gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. GTABase reports the trophy pops after taking the three valuables (luxury watch in the south-east office, Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, safe in the north-east hallway — bring sticky bombs) and losing the police; you do not need all three in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is a partnership moment with mass appeal. Play with your partner and do something the crowd would love — the description names no count or place, so treat it as a story-adjacent world moment that comes from playing together. It is not a one-shot condition in the description, so keep playing as a pair and it will come.
steps: Look for a big shared moment
It unlocks from the partnership scene

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

locations.label: Fitness clubs — Map > Activities; work out with your partner along

trophies.locations_note: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Training one trains the other too; after the story you can also train at home (GTABase).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is about choices — PlayStation tracks a count toward it, so keep making story and world choices as you play and it will come. Nothing in the description names a single choice, so do not hunt for one; it builds up across a normal playthrough.
steps: Make choices when the game offers them
It unlocks as the count builds

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; most players get it without trying. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent (GTABase). No fixed location.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is about succeeding on a second try — fail something once, then get it right the second time. It will likely come naturally during a normal playthrough; do not force it, and do not worry about which attempt it was.
steps: Attempt a challenge and fail it once

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: Location unconfirmed: the exact steps are not confirmed yet (GTABase, 19 Nov). 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: From the official description, this is a strange sighting — something unexplained in the world. Explore the odd corners of Leonida at odd hours and it will find you; the description deliberately says no more. This guide invents no location for it, because no verified source names one yet.
steps: Explore the stranger corners of Leonida
Keep an eye out for something unexplained
It unlocks when the moment happens

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: Location unconfirmed: expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but no verified source names a place yet (GTABase, 19 Nov) — this guide lists none rather than inventing one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From the official description, bowl people over with a melee drive-by — knock them down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass past a group and swing as you go by. It is repeatable, so a missed swing just means another pass.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Strike with the melee weapon as you pass

source.name: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (PlanetGTA6 mirror)

trophies.locations_note: No fixed location: knock people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass past a group and swing as you go by (GTABase).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: From the official description, earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Find your laundering contacts, hand over marked bills, and bank the clean money until $250,000 is done. It is a slow grind, so launder little and often as you play instead of saving it all for the end.

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

locations.label: Tyrone — La Perle, Vice City (Chapter 3+; high price for narcotics)
Yasmani — Little Cuba, Vice City (Chapter 3+; high price for marked bills)
Dunk — Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2+; low price)
Brian — South Key Lento (Chapter 1; very low price)
Donnie — South Key Lento (Chapter 1; low price)

trophies.locations_note: Marked bills come from robberies; the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check lets you fence them. Fence prices differ per contact and per goods type, so hold marked bills for Yasmani from Chapter 3 if you can.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: From the official description, spend $100,000 across all shops. Total spending across every shop counts — weapons, clothes, food, cars, anything the shops sell. Spend as you play and the total builds; big purchases near the end can close the gap.
steps: Buy what you need in any shop

source.name: GTA 6 trophy list — OutpuTLag

trophies.locations_note: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest (GTABase) — gun stores, mod shops and tattoo parlours are the quickest route; no single shop is required.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: From the official description, purchase all garage properties — the list tracks 8 garages. Save up, then buy each one; check the property list in-game to see which are still unowned. Garages are also useful for the vehicle trophies, so buy them as you can afford them.

source.name: GTA 6 achievements list — GTAViceCityHub

7th Avenue Garage — Vice-Dale County, just east of the airport — $12,000
Store n' Bolt — north side of Ambrosia, Kelly County — $16,800
Wyatt Motors — central Ambrosia, a short way south-east of Store n' Bolt — $21,600

Atlantic Court Garage — Ocean Beach, on Vice City's beachfront — $40,000
Persistence Road Garage — western Bellville, south Leonard County, just north of Vice City (price not published — check the app)
Vela Rota Drive Garage — Capri (price not published — check the app)

trophies.locations_note: Buy through the Vice City Real Estate app, which installs after an early Chapter 2 job for Moses. Total for all 8 reported as $160,000 (GamesRecon). Story and edition garages (Port Gellhorn Station, Paradise, Shore Court) do not count toward the 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: From the official description, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the app and register it, then move on to the next — ten registrations in total. Any vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive for the vehicle-discovery trophy.
steps: Register it in the Scooter Bros app

source.name: GTA 6 achievements list — GTAViceCityHub

locations.label: Moses' garage — Port Gellhorn
Pay 'n' Spray — registers tracked vehicles from Chapter 3

trophies.locations_note: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes (GTABase).
